From Wiktionary, the free dictionary

Asturian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From rápidu +‎ -ez.

Noun

[edit]

rapidez f (uncountable)

  1. speed (rapidity)
    Synonym: velocidá

Further reading

[edit]
  • “rapidez”, in Diccionariu de la llingua asturiana [Dictionary of the Asturian Language] (in Asturian), 1ª edición, Academia de la Llingua Asturiana, 2000, →ISBN

Portuguese

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From rápido +‎ -ez.

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ʁa.piˈde(j)s/ [ha.piˈde(ɪ̯)s]
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ʁa.piˈde(j)s/ [ha.piˈde(ɪ̯)s]
    • (Rio de Janeiro) IPA(key): /ʁa.piˈde(j)ʃ/ [χa.piˈde(ɪ̯)ʃ]
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ʁɐ.piˈdeʃ/ [ʁɐ.piˈðeʃ]

  • Rhymes: -eʃ
  • Hyphenation: ra‧pi‧dez

Noun

[edit]

rapidez f (usually uncountable, plural rapidezes)

  1. speed; rapidity
    Synonym: velocidade
    Antonyms: demora, lentidão, morosidade

Further reading

[edit]
  • “rapidez”, in Dicionário Aulete Digital (in Portuguese), Rio de Janeiro: Lexikon Editora Digital, 2008–2026
  • “rapidez”, in Dicionário inFormal (in Portuguese), 2006–2026
  • “rapidez” in Dicionário Aberto based on Novo Diccionário da Língua Portuguesa de Cândido de Figueiredo, 1913
  • “rapidez”, in Dicionário infopédia da Lingua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), Porto: Porto Editora, 2003–2026
  • “rapidez”, in Michaelis Dicionário Brasileiro da Língua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), São Paulo: Editora Melhoramentos, 2015–2026, →ISBN
  • “rapidez”, in Dicionário Priberam da Língua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), Lisbon: Priberam, 2008–2026

Spanish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From rápido +‎ -ez.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /rapiˈdeθ/ [ra.piˈð̞eθ] (Spain, Equatorial Guinea)
  • IPA(key): /rapiˈdes/ [ra.piˈð̞es] (Latin America, Philippines)
  • Rhymes: -eθ (Spain, Equatorial Guinea)
  • Rhymes: -es (Latin America, Philippines)
  • Syllabification: ra‧pi‧dez

Noun

[edit]

rapidez f (plural rapideces)

  1. speed

Further reading

[edit]
  • “rapidez”, in Diccionario de la lengua española [Dictionary of the Spanish Language] (in Spanish), online version 23.8.1, Royal Spanish Academy [Spanish: Real Academia Española], 15 December 2025
